# sofa_resp_sim

Repository: https://github.com/reblocke/sofa_resp_sim
Purpose: Simulation to explore SOFA respiratory score generation from EHR data at elevation
Status: No manuscript version is expected. Code and simulation text are repository-authored unless otherwise noted.

## Human-Readable Entry Points
- `README.md` is the primary human-facing overview.
- `llms.txt` is a compact machine-readable index and should not replace the README.

## Agent Cautions
- Do not re-add a README appendix aimed primarily at LLMs; integrate user-facing details into normal README sections.
